mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox (topic, payload, payload_type, tag, dedup_key, hash_key, headers, status, attempts, next_retry_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{topic}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb), #{payloadType}, #{tag}, #{dedupKey}, #{hashKey}, CAST(#{headers} AS jsonb), #{status}, #{attempts}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM outbox WHERE (status = 'pending' AND next_retry_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'claiming' AND #{now} - updated_at > (#{claimingTimeoutSeconds} || ' seconds')::interval) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox SET status = 'pending', attempts = #{attempts}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, failure_reason = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
